Company Policy and Security Guide
1. Password Policy
Passwords must contain at least 12 characters and should include a mixture of uppercase letters, lowercase
letters, numbers, and symbols. Passwords must not be shared with another person.
2. Account Lockout
An account is locked after 5 consecutive failed authentication attempts. The employee must follow the approved
account-recovery process to regain access.
3. Expense Approval
Expenses up to INR 10,000 may be approved by the employee's manager. Expenses above INR 10,000 require
manager and department-head approval.
4. Data Classification
Confidential company information must be accessed only by authorized employees. Sensitive information must
not be copied to personal storage or sent to personal email.
5. Incident Reporting
Security incidents should be reported to the security operations team as soon as they are identified. The report
should include the time, affected system, and a short description.

Employee_Handbook.pdf.preview:
Employee Handbook
1. Annual Leave
Full-time employees receive 24 days of annual leave per calendar year. Employees may carry forward a
maximum of 10 unused annual-leave days into the following calendar year.
2. Sick Leave
Employees receive 12 days of sick leave per calendar year. Sick leave should be reported to the manager as
soon as reasonably possible.
3. Work From Home
Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week, subject to team requirements and manager approval.
Production support rotations may require employees to work from the office.
4. Travel Policy
Domestic business travel requires manager approval. International business travel requires manager and
business-unit approval. Economy class is the standard for flights under 6 hours.
5. Benefits
Eligible employees receive medical insurance, accidental coverage, and access to the company's employee
assistance program.

Smart Thermostat X100 — Product Specification
1. Product Overview
The Smart Thermostat X100 is an indoor temperature controller designed for residential use. It supports Wi-Fi
connectivity, programmable schedules, and remote monitoring.
2. Installation
Install the thermostat on an interior wall away from direct sunlight and drafts. For reliable connectivity, keep the
device within a strong Wi-Fi coverage area.
